Live TV, movies, series, search, favorites, continue watching and the TV guide are available. Guide information depends on what your source supports. Antenio collects no analytics, telemetry or advertising identifiers. Your source accounts, catalog cache, PIN and lock settings are stored encrypted on this device with an Android Keystore key (AES-GCM). Favorites, watch history and resume points stay unencrypted in storage only the app can read. None of it goes into cloud backup or device transfer, and none is sent to third parties. The app connects only to the source and guide addresses you add and the stream and image addresses they list; while Add with your phone is open, it serves a setup page on your home network.
